name: stripo
description: Stripo email creation, editing, localization, images, Business Profile updates

interface.shortDescription: Stripo's AI agent. Create and edit Stripo emails
interface.longDescription: Create emails from a brief, template, HTML or screenshot. Generate and edit images, update text, links and styles in existing emails and templates, and review desktop and mobile previews.
defaultPrompt: Create a Stripo email from my reference and verify its saved desktop and mobile previews.
Translate and clone a Stripo email while preserving every language.
Update my Stripo Business Profile from the information I provide.
